# Attribution and license

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance in mathematical
reasoning, source reading, implementation, experiments and documentation.
This package is contributed under the repository Apache-2.0 license.
Retained predecessor notices and source-specific licenses remain unchanged.

The generic dyadic lift/one-round principle, unitary norm estimates and
nearest-up arithmetic are prior tools, not claimed as new discoveries. The
new work is the literal selected #6030 complete-MOVE source/descriptor and
lifecycle composition, widened-parent permission for every serial consumer,
full expanded invoice, and actual-source rounding-order controls.

Credited public predecessors include:

- Rounded positive leaf `3a6b01655f9f0893cef52563a63d79b3295bc67d`.
- Exact direct MOVE `a61652557fa88cd0b24c1b28445cf519f6b1213e`.
- LEAF-private cutoff transport `785000b8f400609943cd9ff04843317af4ae67a4`.
- Serial monomials `2ec95e06c2a16e73f9da9a8fe41912710135daaf`.
- All-source rank leaf `12e58dfdad9371a26f9978c814779da344fd80b4`.
- Actual-input precision contract `56bc9383594a3efc303148e00bb746851abd1ed5`.
- Canonical #6030 source, earlier physical Gaussian/monomial/Compact,
  header/dispatcher/codec/lifecycle and atomic-provider work identified in
  the exact retained dependency and provenance manifests.

The original-circuit integer oracle is retained unchanged from the direct
predecessor with its credit. This wave reuses it for two new source-specific
rounding controls; it does not call rerunning the same production code an
independent proof. Separate lead review is model-assisted and shares source
context, not independent human or proof-kernel admission.
